definitions: The property possessed by an object of producing different sensations on the eye as a result of the way it reflects or emits light.
The use of all colours, not just black and white.
The natural fresh colour of the skin, indicative of health.
A particular colour used as a symbol or emblem by a group or organisation.
examples: Add some colour to the paint.
She had good colour in her cheeks.
The school colours are blue and gold.
